# Diversity Certification

> > The Institute for Diversity Certification (IDC) offers professional DEI credentials including CDP® and CDE® certifications to advance diversity, equity, and inclusion leadership in organizations.

Diversity Certification is the official platform for IDC's professional certification programs in diversity, equity, and inclusion. The site provides comprehensive resources for certification candidates, exam preparation, and ongoing professional development for credentialed designees across global regions.

## Key Topics

- Certified Diversity Professional (CDP®)
- Certified Diversity Executive (CDE®)
- DEI Certification
- Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
- Professional Credentials
- Exam Preparation
- AI Bias & Machine Learning Bias (AMBP-L™)
- Continuing Education
- Recertification
- IDC Membership
- Professional Development
- Americas, EMEA, APAC Regions
- Inclusive Excellence
- Diversity Training

## Core Certifications

- [Certified Diversity Professional (CDP®) | DEI Skills](https://www.diversitycertification.org/certification/certified-diversity-professional-cdp): CDP® credential for developing DEI skills and workplace leadership
- [Certified Diversity Executive (CDE®) | DEI Leaders](https://www.diversitycertification.org/certification/certified-diversity-executive-cde): CDE® credential for DEI executive leadership and inclusion
- [AMBP-L™ Certification: Remove AI bias, Machine Learning Bias](https://www.diversitycertification.org/certification/ambp-l): AMBP-L™ certification for identifying and removing AI/ML bias
- [CDP® or CDE®: Choosing the Right DEI Certification](https://www.diversitycertification.org/certification-candidates): Guide to choosing between CDP® and CDE® DEI certifications
- [Certificate vs. Certification: The Difference in DEI](https://www.diversitycertification.org/certification/certificate-versus-certification): Explains differences between DEI certificates and certifications

## Exam Preparation & Study Resources

- [CDP® Exam Prep: Prepare for Your DEI Certification Exam](https://www.diversitycertification.org/certification/cdp/americas-exam-preparation): CDP® exam preparation courses and study materials for Americas
- [CDP® D&I Certification Class Schedules in EMEA+APAC](https://www.diversitycertification.org/certification/cdp/emea-apac-exam-preparation): CDP® certification class schedules for EMEA and APAC regions
- [CDE® Exam Prep: Get Certified and Level-Up Your Career](https://www.diversitycertification.org/certification/cde/americas-exam-preparation): CDE® exam prep courses and self-study for Americas region
- [EDI Certification Class Schedules for EMEA+APAC](https://www.diversitycertification.org/certification/cde/emea-apac-exam-preparation): CDE® certification class schedules for EMEA and APAC regions
- [DEI Certification Resources | Diversity Training](https://www.diversitycertification.org/certification/resources): Resources for DEI certification candidates and designees
- [DEI Certification FAQs | About CDP® & CDE® Credentials](https://www.diversitycertification.org/certification/frequently-asked-questions): FAQs about CDP and CDE credentials and certification benefits

## Professional Development & Continuing Education

- [IDC Designees | Credentialed Professionals Resources](https://www.diversitycertification.org/certification/cdp-cde-recertification): Recertification and continuing education for CDP/CDE designees
- [IDC Designees | Credentialed Professionals Resources](https://www.diversitycertification.org/certification/refresher-courses): Refresher courses for CDP and CDE credentialed professionals
- [IDC® Membership Society | DEI Professional Association](https://www.diversitycertification.org/membership): IDC membership society for DEI professionals and association
- [Member Benefits | IDC DEI Professional Association](https://www.diversitycertification.org/membership/member-benefits): IDC membership benefits and professional development offerings

## Certification Administration

- [IDC® Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Certification Fees](https://www.diversitycertification.org/certification/cdp-cde-fees-policies): CDP and CDE certification fees, pricing, and registration info
- [IDC Partners | Our Network of DEI Professionals](https://www.diversitycertification.org/certification/partners): IDC partner network of DEI professionals and organizations

## Learning Platforms & Testing

- [CourseNetworking (The CN) Learning Management System](https://www.diversitycertification.org/certification/thecn): CourseNetworking LMS platform for DEI certification courses
- [Talogy: Secure Online Testing for IDC® Certification](https://www.diversitycertification.org/certification/talogy): Talogy secure testing platform for CDP and CDE exams
